relationships.evidence_quote: The monoclonal fully humanized antibody targets the CGRP receptor [2].

relationships.subject: Erenumab
relationships.evidence_quote: In our cohort, constipation (3mo n = 24, 6mo n = 13, 9mo n = 11, 12mo n = 8) was the most documented AE

key_findings: Erenumab was well tolerated up to 12 months in 128 migraine patients; AEs were nearly all grade 1 with no dose dependence and no habituation.
Females and patients with aura reported more AEs; constipation and skin reactions were most common.
